description: Unit tests for the parse tree functionality in the GN build system, including accessor, subscripted access, variable usage, target shortening, range extraction, and integer parsing.

classes.name: AccessorNode
classes.description: Represents a member access node in the parse tree, with methods to set base and member tokens, and execute the access.

classes.name: IdentifierNode
classes.description: Represents an identifier in the parse tree.

classes.name: BinaryOpNode
classes.description: Represents a binary operation node, such as list literals or range expressions.

classes.name: ListNode
classes.description: Represents a list of parse nodes, with methods to shorten targets and get sort ranges.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes the parse node within a given scope, returning a Value and error status.

methods.name: ShortenTargets
methods.description: Simplifies target strings in a list node.

methods.name: GetSortRanges
methods.description: Extracts sorted ranges from a list node.
